$comment: Conventional-commit types and scopes for every email-utils repo. The PR-title check and the Claude skills both read this file, so change them here and nowhere else. `bump` is the release that release-please cuts for a type. `changelog` is the CHANGELOG section it lands in; null means the type is hidden and never cuts a release on its own.

breaking.description: Add ! before the colon, as in feat(presets)!: remove the rfc5321 alias. The PR title becomes the squash commit, so the ! goes in the title.

feat.description: A new feature or public API addition

fix.description: A bug fix. Also used for vendored-data refreshes and runtime dependency bumps, so they ship

perf.description: Faster or smaller, with no change in behavior

revert.description: Reverts an earlier commit; quote its title in the description

docs.description: Documentation only: READMEs, TSDoc, and the docs site

style.description: Formatting only, with no change in behavior

refactor.description: A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature

test.description: Adds or corrects tests, fixtures, or benchmarks

build.description: Build tooling that doesn't change the published package. Use fix when it does

chore.description: Anything else that doesn't ship: repo settings, synced config, dev dependencies

shared.deps: Runtime dependency bumps, including @email-utils/* in dependents
shared.config: Shared config synced from meta's templates

meta.workflows: Reusable workflows and meta's own CI
meta.plugin: The Claude plugin, its skills, and this file
meta.site: The Fumadocs docs site build and deploy

validator-syntax.parser: parseAddress and the grammar behind it
validator-syntax.presets: The practical, rfc5321, rfc5322, and html5 presets and their overrides

classifier.providers: The provider registry and the /providers entry

validator-dns.resolver: DNS lookups, the pluggable resolver, and timeouts
validator-dns.cache: The TTL cache and in-flight dedupe
